name: mingxu
description: A lightweight TypeScript agent runtime and local CLI skeleton.

scripts.build: pnpm clean && pnpm -C packages/tui build && pnpm -C packages/plugin-sdk build && tsc -p tsconfig.json && pnpm -C packages/cli build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -C packages/tui build && pnpm -C packages/plugin-sdk build && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit
scripts.typecheck:src: pnpm -C packages/tui build && pnpm -C packages/plugin-sdk build && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.pretest: pnpm -C packages/tui build && pnpm -C packages/plugin-sdk build
